images.title: The place tells the landmark
images.purpose: Shows 3725 written as 1, 2, 5 in three places, where the position alone says 3600s, 60s or 1s.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three place boxes in a row with grey place names above and the number below.
images.exact_structure: Three equal square boxes in a row with clear space between them, dark outlines. Above them, small grey (#6B7280) headers left to right: 3600s, 60s, 1s. Inside, large teal (#0072B2) numbers left to right: 1, 2, 5. Below the boxes, centred, 3725 in dark text with one short amber (#E69F00) underline. Exactly 3 boxes. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In a place value system, position alone tells which landmark a group counts.
